units.source_text: 在此之前，父親月月都會給我定額的零花錢，

en.t: Until then, my father gave me a fixed allowance every month,

units.source_text: 這些錢就算兩三天花完，香菸、酒、乳酪、水果等，家裡應有盡有，

en.t: even if I spent it all in two or three days, the house always had everything I wanted, such as cigarettes, liquor, cheese, and fruit,

units.source_text: 至於書、文具、衣服等其他東西，隨時都可以在附近的店鋪賒賬購買，

en.t: and as for books, stationery, clothes, and other things, I could buy them on credit at nearby shops whenever I liked,

units.source_text: 就算是請堀木吃蕎麥麵和炸蝦蓋飯，只要是街道上父親經常光顧的餐館，

en.t: even when I treated Horiki to soba noodles or a tempura rice bowl, as long as it was a restaurant in town that my father often patronized,

units.source_text: 我都可以吃完後一聲不吭地走人。

en.t: I could simply finish eating and walk out without saying a word.

units.source_text: 但現在突然一個人租房獨居，

en.t: But now I had suddenly rented a room and was living alone,

units.source_text: 一切花銷都必須在每個月的定額匯款中支出，一下子讓我不知所措。

en.t: and having to pay every expense out of the fixed remittance I received each month left me completely at a loss.
